API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIEmergency Access ManagementUpdates the emergency access user for the specified customer.
Updates the emergency access user for the specified customer.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/emergencyAccess/user/:userId

Updates the emergency access user for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

userId
string
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the emergency access user.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.
